messages:
Priya S: FYI - Escalation from AcmeRetail (P1). After yesterday's model swap we started getting parsing failures and schema drift in structured_output responses. Customer says optional keys are gone and some arrays became objects with numeric keys. They attached logs and a failing webhook payload.

Support Bot: Pasted customer sample (redacted):
```
# expected (before swap)
{
  "order_id": "ORD-12345",
  "items": [
    { "sku": "A1", "qty": 2 },
    { "sku": "B2", "qty": 1 }
  ],
  "meta": { "source": "checkout" }
}

# actual (after swap)
{
  "items": {
    "0": { "sku": "A1", "qty": 2 },
    "1": { "sku": "B2", "qty": 1 }
  },
  "meta": { "order_id": "ORD-12345", "source": "checkout" },
}
```

Priya S: Customer also got `JSONDecodeError: trailing comma` when ingesting streaming chunks. They ran a minimal curl repro against our hosted endpoint: `POST /v1/generate?model=redwood/llama-4b-quant-v3` using their same prompt schema.

Alex M: Is this on canary or full? I thought the v3 swap was partial.

Priya S: Customer says they hit it in prod yesterday and we confirmed their traffic was routed to v3 (not just canary). We flipped the rollout to 100% last night at ~02:10 UTC.

Elaine (SRE): I'm seeing matched traces for the request ids the customer provided. Runtime logs show different chunk boundary behavior for v3 kernels — KV cache chunking plus new batching path seems to emit token groups that split objects mid-property. Example from proxy logs: `...STREAM_CHUNK end-of-object midline -> trailing-comma` which would cause trailing commas when the client concatenates chunks naively.

Mike L: Two angles: 1) schema drift where arrays are emitted as objects with numeric keys (likely model-side generation change), 2) streaming chunk boundaries causing parse errors. Workarounds: post-process to normalize numeric-keyed objects into arrays, or require `structured_output.mode=strict` to enforce array types server-side until we patch.

Alex M: I can roll back the model to `redwood/llama-4b-quant-v2` for the affected route immediately to stop customer impact. Confirming: rollback will restore previous behavior?

Elaine (SRE): Rolling back should revert the kernel path that changed chunking. It won't fix a model-level schema preference if v3 actually learned to prefer object form, but it will stop the streaming-split artifact.

Priya S: Can you do a rollback and then set a canary at 10% while we debug? Also need a clear repro we can run internally.

Support Bot: Created internal incident INC-2024-331 with tags: p1, structured-output, model-swap. Linked ticket: https://redwood.internal/inc/INC-2024-331

Alex M: Rolling back now for route `acme.orders.generate` -> switching model param to `redwood/llama-4b-quant-v2` and setting canary=10%. I'll post when it's live.

Mike L: For repro I ran this short script against v3 and v2 and got different JSON shapes. Snippet: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/llama-4b-quant-v3","prompt":"render order json for items...","structured_output":true}'
```
Compare `jq` outputs. On v3 `jq -c .items | strings` returns object with numeric keys, on v2 it returns array.

Elaine (SRE): Added observability: route-level tracing + sample capture enabled for `acme.orders.generate`. Check trace id `trace:acme-8812` for the failing request. Also added a temporary streaming-join sanitizer in the proxy that tries to avoid adding trailing commas when chunk ends with comma. Will monitor for regressions.

Priya S: Customer notified: we rolled back their route and will run additional validation tests. They're repro-ing now and say ingestion errors dropped dramatically.

Alex M: Rollback complete at 1745010300 (UTC). Canary set to 10%.

Support Bot: Customer updated - ingestion success rate reported at ~99% after rollback. Customer accepted P1 resolution pending root-cause analysis.

Priya S: Next steps: Mike to run parameter sweep to see if v3 prompt conditioning can be fixed (prefer arrays), Elaine to run deeper kernel telemetry and replay for chunking, Alex to keep canary low and coordinate a controlled re-roll with schema tests. I'll follow up with the customer with ETA for RCA. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Mike L: Will add a structured-output unit test (compare types of fields) to the canary pipeline so we catch shape changes before full rollout.

Elaine (SRE): Logging note — capture `stream_chunk_end` + `token_id` context to help correlate cut points.

Priya S: Closing loop with the customer now. I'll keep this thread updated if anything else comes up.
